red.result: Expected failure: no new denial event after first retry; controller payload timeout.
red.cause: Old prototype performs one retry and returns its result even if that retry is denied. Fixture allowance restoration was separated from permission to expose this limit.

incremental.reused: Same C executable, Java classes, producer and dependencies as red; native hook changed.

fresh.recreated: Empty Java class directory and rebuilt C fixture; resulting class and worker bytes equal incremental outputs.

behavior: A denied retry creates a fresh positive wait identity on the same native thread/call, with the original malloc invocation count increasing exactly once.
A duplicate grant for the retired wait and an unknown grant do not release the fresh wait or its peer.
Restoring the fixture address-space allowance does not grant permission; two native waiters remain until explicit permission.
The selected wait succeeds on its third malloc call after two distinct permissions; its peer stays parked until its own permission.
Both callers verify memory endpoints, errno0 and restored limits, then twelve additional matching-size successful allocations finish naturally with root exit0.
Completed call slots are reused; the eight-slot bound now limits simultaneous tracked calls rather than all calls over the installation lifetime.
Cancellation kills/reaps a target with two actual condition waiters before instrumentation teardown.
limitations: One intercepted malloc size and controlled RLIMIT_AS denial only; no general allocator or physical-pressure acceptance.
Eight simultaneous selected calls remain a diagnostic bound; exhaustion and recursive-call failure paths unrun.
Diagnostic pre-wait busy barrier and fixture allowance control are not production mechanisms.
Only known positive identities tested; untrusted decimal bounds and production protocol decoder remain open.
One installation, no descendants/fork/exec-generation composition or production JobQueue.Attempt adapter.
Other native platforms, forced native teardown errors and actual Cargo/Bazel scheduling remain unrun.
Native executable-stack/JVM stack-guard warnings retained; unchanged tooling tests not repeated.

remote.transport: One authenticated persistent Upterm SSH connection retained through red, correction, incremental/fresh tests, collection and cleanup.

source_mapping: All57 remote manifest members and all15 outer manifest members verified. Executed hook/fixture/controller and four maintained Java source bytes verified against local inputs; fresh/incremental class and C executable bytes equal.
